Here is how to modify Start-EchoAll.ps1 to load the correct planner.
The Fix: Open: Start-EchoAll.ps1 Find: The section "Model paths (fallback to defaults)" (around line 130). Replace: The ECHO_SMALL_MODEL_PATH and ECHO_SMALL_MODEL_NAME blocks with the code below.
# --- CHANGES: Update the alias to match the filename so Start-Echo finds it ---
1. Swaps the Model: It tells llama-server on Port 8081 to load AgentFlow...ps1p instead
